events.event_name: CookUnity: The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas with eight chefs serving CookUnity dishes from behind the counter.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made CookUnity meals and hot bites while supplies last; guests also receive bodega-style scratch-off tickets for prize chances.
events.caveats: Walk-in giveaway; food is while supplies last. Lines are expected and no meal is guaranteed after inventory runs out.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five Manhattan bodegas in Flatiron, Chelsea, Midtown, West Village and Murray Hill.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first NYC cafe and retail pop-up celebrating the Mocha Magic fragrance with cafe drinks, fragrance sampling and exclusive merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling plus a special gift for the first 50 guests in line each day; additional gifts are tied to purchase.
events.caveats: The first-50 gift is while supplies last each day. The pop-up is publicly shoppable; products and cafe items may cost money.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily at 262 Mott St. A Partiful RSVP exists, but current source evidence also describes the public retail pop-up as open to walk-ins, so RSVP is treated as optional rather than required.

events.event_name: Happy Camp3r: The Sweetest Stop in NYC
events.what_it_is: Happy Camp3r's first NYC pop-up, with new apparel styles, sweet treats, photo moments, experiences and surprises.
events.what_is_free: Public entry; the source advertises sweet treats and surprises but does not establish a guaranteed free item for every visitor.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Merchandise is for sale; do not represent unspecified surprises or treats as guaranteed giveaways.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM daily at 251 Elizabeth St.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A Japanese-wellness themed Apothékary takeover of SUKOSHI with tongue readings, ingredient education, tincture sampling and kakigori.
events.what_is_free: Tincture samples and kakigori while supplies last; the first 50 guests in line each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture. A gift with purchase is separate.
events.caveats: Eventbrite is the organizer listing. First-50 minis and kakigori are supply-limited; the 20% discount and additional gift-with-purchase do not make purchase required for entry.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18 is 1–9 PM; Saturday Sept. 19 and Sunday Sept. 20 are 9 AM–9 PM. Use the organizer Eventbrite listing for registration/current availability.

events.address: LilliStar at Moxy Williamsburg, 353 Bedford Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11211
events.what_it_is: 8it's one-day food and culture festival debuting chef collaborations, Hennessy drinks, unreleased DJ music and a New York Penn fashion drop.
events.what_is_free: Ticketed attendees age 21+ receive a welcome Hennessy cocktail; a completed food-drop passport earns a limited New York Penn tote. Food drops are otherwise purchased separately.
events.caveats: 21+. General admission is $15 in advance and $20 at the door; food drops are purchased separately onsite. Reserved group tables are $500.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 2–8 PM, rain or shine, on the LilliStar rooftop at Moxy Williamsburg.

occurrences.details: Walk in at any of five listed Manhattan bodegas. Complimentary meals/hot bites are while supplies last.
21+. $15 advance / $20 door; food drops purchased separately onsite.
